name: Zevvo File Upload for WooCommerce
author: zevvolabs

sections.description:
Zevvo File Upload for WooCommerce allows your customers to upload files directly on product pages and have those files automatically attached to their orders. Whether you run a print-on-demand store, a custom gift shop, or any business that needs customer-supplied files, Zevvo handles it securely and smoothly.

Built from the ground up for HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility, it works with both the classic and block-based WooCommerce cart and checkout.

Features

  • Product-Level Configuration — Enable file uploads per product with its own settings
  • Required Upload Option — Mark the upload field as required before adding to cart
  • Flexible File Types — Support for JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, PDF, and ZIP — toggle per product
  • File Size Control — Set maximum file size per product (default: 10 MB)
  • Multiple Files — Allow up to 5 files per product upload field
  • Drag & Drop Interface — Clean, responsive drag-and-drop upload zone with keyboard support
  • File Previews — In-browser image and PDF previews before upload
  • Thumbnail Previews in Cart & Orders — Image thumbnails and file icons in cart, checkout, and order pages
  • Admin File Dashboard — View, download, trash, and permanently delete all uploaded files from one screen
  • CSV Export — Export all uploaded file data to CSV for reporting
  • Trash & Restore — Soft-delete files with one-click restore from trash
  • Automatic Cleanup — Daily cron job removes uploads that were never ordered (after 48 hours)
  • Order Integration — Files automatically attach to orders at checkout and display in order details
  • Email Notifications — Links to uploaded files included in WooCommerce order emails
  • HPOS Compatible — Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Blocks Compatible — Works with Gutenberg block-based cart and checkout
  • Protected File Links — Files are served through signed links, and direct access to the upload folder is blocked
  • Order Files Panel — See every uploaded file on the order edit screen and download them all as one ZIP
  • Smart Shop Buttons — Products that require an upload send shoppers to the product page instead of adding to cart from the shop
  • Privacy Tools — Uploaded files are included in WordPress personal data export and erasure requests
  • Secure Storage — Files stored with randomized names in a protected directory (.htaccess + index.php)
  • Developer Hooks — Filters and actions for extending behavior without modifying plugin files

Perfect For

  • Print-on-demand stores (T-shirts, mugs, posters, etc.)
  • Custom engraving or embroidery shops
  • Personalized gift and keepsake stores
  • Photo printing and canvas services
  • Graphic design and artwork commissions
  • Legal, medical, or document processing services
  • Any WooCommerce store that needs customer-supplied files

Security & Reliability

  • Strict MIME type validation using WordPress’s wp_check_filetype_and_ext()
  • Server-side re-validation on every upload request
  • Files stored with MD5-hashed filenames — original names are never exposed on disk
  • Files served only through signed, unguessable links; direct folder access blocked with .htaccess (Apache 2.2 and 2.4)
  • index.php sentinel file prevents directory browsing on all servers
  • Per-session upload abuse limit (configurable via filter) prevents server exhaustion
  • Per-page-load context ID system enforces per-product file count limits strictly
  • Nonce verification on all AJAX requests and form submissions
  • Server-side checks that every file added to the cart belongs to the shopper who uploaded it
  • GDPR-friendly: automatic cleanup of unattached files, plus WordPress privacy export and erase support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/zevvo-file-uploads, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Click Settings under the plugin name on the Plugins page, or go to WooCommerce → Zevvo Uploads
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product and find the Zevvo File Uploads metabox in the product sidebar
  5. Check Enable File Uploads, choose allowed file types, set size and count limits, then save
  6. Customers will now see the upload field on that product’s page
sections.faq:
Is this compatible with HPOS?

Yes. Zevvo File Upload is built specifically for WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and works with both HPOS and legacy (post-based) order storage.

What file types are supported?

The plugin supports JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, PDF, and ZIP. Each file type can be toggled on or off per product from the product metabox.

Where are files stored?

Files are stored in your WordPress uploads directory at wp-content/uploads/zevvo_uploads/. Filenames are randomized for security. Since version 1.1.0 files are delivered through signed links (for example https://example.com/?zevvo_file=12&zevvo_sig=...), and the folder itself is blocked with .htaccess.

Note for Nginx users: .htaccess rules don’t apply on Nginx. Add a rule to your server block so the folder can’t be opened directly, for example: location ^~ /wp-content/uploads/zevvo_uploads/ { deny all; }. Signed links keep working because they don’t point at the folder.

I updated from 1.0.0. Will old file links in emails still work?

Yes. On sites updated from 1.0.0, direct folder access stays allowed so links in emails you already sent keep working. New emails use signed links. When you’re ready, turn on Protect file links under WooCommerce → Zevvo Uploads → Settings.

Can I set a file size limit?

Yes. Each product has its own maximum file size setting (in MB). The default is 10 MB.

How do I view uploaded files?

Go to WooCommerce → Zevvo Uploads in your admin. You’ll see all uploaded files with options to view (with in-admin preview), download, move to trash, or permanently delete.

Are files shown in order emails?

Yes. Each uploaded file is listed under its product as a link in WooCommerce order emails sent to customers and admins. WooCommerce removes images from item details in emails, so thumbnails are not shown there.

What happens to files when an order is cancelled?

Files stay attached to the order. They are deleted automatically only when the order is permanently deleted or its personal data is removed. You can also trash or delete them from the admin dashboard.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes. File upload settings are configured on the parent product and apply to all variations.

Can customers upload multiple files?

Yes. You can allow 1 to 5 files per product. The upload field displays a counter showing how many files have been selected out of the allowed maximum.

Can I make the upload field required?

Yes. Check the Required Field option in the product metabox. Customers will not be able to add the product to cart without uploading at least one file.

Is there a file upload limit per order?

No order-level limit. Each product in the cart can have its own independent file upload configuration.

What about theme compatibility?

The plugin works with any properly-coded WooCommerce theme. It uses standard WooCommerce hooks for classic themes, and includes Store API integration for block-based cart and checkout.

Can I export uploaded files data?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce → Zevvo Uploads, navigate to the Process Uploads tab, and click the Export CSV button to download all file records as a CSV file.

How does automatic cleanup work?

A daily WordPress cron job removes files that were uploaded but never ordered once they are older than 48 hours (the length of a WooCommerce cart session). Files you move to the Trash are permanently deleted after the number of days set in Settings (default 30). Files attached to orders are never deleted by the cleanup job.

How do I customize file upload behavior with code?

The plugin provides the following filters and actions for developers:

Filters:
* zevvo_allowed_file_types — Modify allowed MIME types for a product ($types, $product_id)
* zevvo_max_upload_size — Modify the maximum file size in MB ($size_mb, $product_id)
* zevvo_max_files_count — Modify the maximum number of files ($max_files, $product_id)
* zevvo_session_abuse_limit — Change the per-session global upload ceiling ($limit)
* zevvo_pending_file_lifetime — How long unattached uploads are kept, in seconds ($seconds)
* zevvo_can_access_file — Allow or deny access to a file behind a signed link ($allowed, $file)

Actions:
* zevvo_validate_upload — Run custom validation before a file is saved ($file, $post_id)
* zevvo_files_attached_to_order — Fires after uploaded files are attached to an order ($order, $file_ids)

See the docs/DEVELOPER-HOOKS.md file in the plugin directory for usage examples.

Is this GDPR compliant?

Unattached files are deleted automatically after 48 hours. Files attached to an order are removed when the order is deleted or anonymized. Uploaded files are included in WordPress’s Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data tools, and the plugin adds suggested text to your privacy policy guide.

Does it work with Gutenberg blocks?

Yes. The plugin includes a Gutenberg block for product pages and is fully compatible with the WooCommerce block-based cart and checkout via the Store API integration.

What if I need help?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 – 2026-11-15

Fixed
* Files uploaded with the block-based checkout were never attached to the order and could be deleted by the daily cleanup. They are now attached on both classic and block checkout, and the update reattaches affected files from earlier block-checkout orders that have not been deleted yet.
* On sites with a timezone behind UTC (for example the Americas), uploading a new file could delete files the shopper had just uploaded. Cleanup now uses the site’s local time.
* Files already in the cart were deleted if the shopper uploaded another file more than an hour later.
* Unattached uploads are now kept for 48 hours (matching the WooCommerce cart session) instead of 24.
* The “Auto-delete” setting no longer deletes files attached to orders. It now permanently removes files that have been in the Trash for the set number of days.
* The upload table could not be created on MySQL servers in strict mode (NO_ZERO_DATE). Existing tables are updated safely.
* A file rejected for exceeding the file limit was left on disk.
* The Gutenberg block rejected every file and ignored the product’s settings and developer filters.
* Unchecking every file type allowed any file type WordPress accepts. It now falls back to the default types.
* An empty or zero maximum file size no longer breaks uploads, and the limit never exceeds the server’s own upload limit.
* File previews never appeared in the block-based cart and checkout, because the Store API extension was registered too late. They now show.
* The upload field could render twice when both the block and the product hook were used.
* The correct product is now detected inside shortcodes, quick views and block templates.
* Error messages were shown with HTML entities (for example &) instead of plain text.

Security
* Files added to the cart are checked on the server: they must belong to the shopper and be unused.
* “Required” uploads are enforced on the server for classic, AJAX and Store API add to cart, not only in the browser.
* Files are delivered through signed links, and direct access to the upload folder can be blocked (on by default for new installs).
* .htaccess rules updated for Apache 2.4 (Require all denied) while keeping Apache 2.2 support.
* File names and links in the block cart are escaped before display.
* CSV export protects against spreadsheet formula injection.
* Upload and remove requests handle a missing WooCommerce session safely.

Compatibility
* Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.
* Declares compatibility with WooCommerce Cart & Checkout blocks, removing the “incompatible plugin” warning.
* Block cart and checkout are detected in block-theme templates, not only in page content.
* Classic cart and checkout pages (the shortcode or the editor’s “Classic Cart/Checkout” block) show file previews even when the store’s default cart or checkout page uses blocks.
* Gutenberg block moved to block.json with API version 3 for the iframed editor, and no longer uses the deprecated wp-editor script.
* Front-end scripts load only on product pages with uploads enabled.
* All interface text, including JavaScript messages and admin menu titles, can now be translated.
* The database upgrade runs automatically after an update, including on sites that auto-update.

Added
* Uploaded files panel on the order edit screen (HPOS and legacy) with previews, downloads and a “Download all (ZIP)” button.
* Shop pages show “Select options” for products that require an upload, so shoppers go to the product page first.
* WordPress personal data export and erase support, suggested privacy policy text, and automatic file removal when an order is deleted or anonymized.
* “Protect file links” setting.
* “Delete all data on uninstall” setting. Uninstalling now keeps your files and settings unless you turn this on.
* Developer hooks: zevvo_files_attached_to_order, zevvo_can_access_file, zevvo_pending_file_lifetime.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Per-product file upload configuration with enable/disable toggle
  • Required upload field option — prevents add-to-cart without a file
  • Support for JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, PDF, and ZIP file types
  • Drag-and-drop upload zone with keyboard accessibility and in-browser file preview
  • Up to 5 files per product
  • Admin dashboard with file view, download, trash, restore, and permanent delete
  • CSV export of all upload records
  • Thumbnail previews in cart, checkout, and order detail pages
  • File previews (thumbnails + icons) in WooCommerce order emails
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility declared
  • Block-based cart and checkout support via WooCommerce Store API
  • Secure file storage: randomized (hashed) filenames, protected upload directory
  • Per-session abuse limit and per-page-load context ID for strict file count enforcement
  • Automatic daily cron cleanup of orphaned pending files
  • Developer filters: zevvo_allowed_file_types, zevvo_max_upload_size, zevvo_max_files_count, zevvo_session_abuse_limit
  • Developer action: zevvo_validate_upload
  • Mobile-responsive interface
